sentences.sentence: The prosecutor in a rural California agricultural community says that police officers there preyed on the poor, impounding their cars then selling the vehicles when the owners couldn't afford the fees.

The prosecutor alleges that the scheme, which spanned over a decade, involved officers of the King City Police Department confiscating vehicles of people who could not afford to pay traffic stops fines, citations, or other fees.
The police officers would then turn the vehicles over to a local towing yard, where the owner of the impound lot would give the vehicles to the police department.
The police department would then sell the cars and use the money for department expenses.
The district attorney, Tony Gattie of Monterey County, said that the owners of the impound lot, and some police officers were paid with the money earned from selling the cars.
The prosecutor also said that, after the money was given to the police, some of it was spent on police equipment and some was used by the police to fund events in the community.
Six police officers have been arrested.
The former police chief, Dennis Yiremenon, was arrested and has been charged with misusing the money from the car sales.
The current interim police chief, Kenneth Denkes, was also arrested.
The prosecutor said that he has a lot of evidence, and that the former police chief and the current interim police chief did it for a long time.
The former police chief, Yiremenon, has pleaded not guilty.
Interim Chief, Dees, says he did nothing wrong.
The police chief said that the department is under 7 full-time police officers.
With six of those people being arrested, the police department is now short-staffed.
The CNN affiliate in the area said that the police are worried if they can keep the police department open.
The case began when a state audit was done, and the auditor found out that some of the money was missing.
Former world No.
1s Maria Shapova and Caroline Wozniacki lit up the court at the Miami Masters on Thursday, but the lights went out on Agnieszka Radwanska and Marion Bartol's in their quarterfinal match.
A power outage that stopped the game twice during a tiebreaker at 2-2, and one last time for a changeover, ultimately had little effect on Radwanska's play.
Agnieszka Radwanska won 5-7, 6-3, 6-2  over 6th seeded Marion Bartol to reach the final four of the Miami Open for the third time.

In the women's quarterfinals, Russian 2nd seed and former Miami Open champion  Maria Shapova had no problem with the power outages and went on to defeat her 15th seeded opponent 6-4, 6-3, and move into her fourth Miami Open final.
On the men's side of the tournament, No.
1 ranked Novak Djokovic won his fourth match in a row  in Miami and moved into his eighth semifinal here.
He beat No.
15  seed David Ferrer 7-5, 6-3.
In the men's quarterfinals the 24th seeded Argentine, Juan Monaco beat No.
6  U.S. No.
1, Mardy Fish  3-6, 6-2, 6-2 to advance to the final four of the Miami Open.
A Florida teen attacked and set on fire last month, allegedly by 5 teenage friends, was undergoing skin graft surgery Friday, the first procedure in his recovery, a hospital spokeswoman said.
Michael Brewer, who is 15 years old, remains in a guarded condition and will be returned to the intensive care unit after the operation, the spokesperson said.

The brutal incident occurred on October 12, when an alleged altercation between the victim and his attackers turned violent, leaving Brewer with severe second-degree burns covering over 65% of his body.

Following the attack, Michael's condition was stabilized in critical condition, the burns were extensive, and a lot of efforts have been made to get him ready for this very important first step in his long and hard recovery.
We wish him the best.
Meanwhile, 3 of the 5 teens accused of setting Michael on fire plead not guilty to attempted murder charges and they will see if they can prove their innocence in court.

The mystery of what really happened to the crew has lingered for nearly 160 years and despite a lot of digging, not much is known.
After months of trying to find the answers to their story, one of the hardest things for Ms. Abrams has been trying to identify the rest of the crew through DNA.
So far, DNA tests have only matched one of the crew, a William Alexander, and it was a match with a descendant who lives out of the country.
The other seven men still remain a mystery.
In an effort to find more information about the crew, Ms. Abrams traveled to Texas to match handwriting samples with a few people who thought they might be related to one of the crew members.
The trip took two days and she was there for two weeks, but nothing came of it.
She also went to Kentucky but the lead was nothing but hearsay.
Hunley, Lieutenant George Simon, had a gold coin as a gift from a lady friend in Baltimore, and it was never found.
The story says that Lieutenant Simon had given the coin to a family member who had children, and that it is still in the family today.
Ms. Abrams has been working on this case for months and says that she has not given up yet.
Defender Per Mertesaker has called on Arsenal to show their Barclays Premier League challenge is very much 'alive' when they head to West Brom for Saturday's lunchtime kick-off.
The Gunners produced a much-improved, composed display in their previous outing, but even though they managed to salvage a point, they are still eight points behind the league leaders.
This isn't an ideal start for Arteta's team and the coach and the players will be hoping to get a good result on Saturday to get the momentum on their side.

Arsenal sit eighth in the Premier League table and Per Mertesacker is calling for an improvement, he wants his team to focus on getting a win on Saturday to show the league that they still have what it takes to be top dogs.
Per Mertesaker said that Arsenal had the quality to win the league, but they just need to put it all together.
He said "We have the squad, we have the quality, we have the players who can do it.
We just need to put it all together, we need to show that we can still win the league".
They play West Brom on Saturday at the Hawthorns and a win is all that will do.
The Gunners need a good result to get them back on track, a win will show the league that they are still serious contenders, if they lose it will be hard to get back in the race.
The coach and the players will be looking to give a good performance, the fans will be looking for a win and the team will be looking to get the three points.
Per Mertesaker and the rest of the players are looking to focus on the game ahead, not on the past.
They just want to get a good result on Saturday, they want to get the three points and get the momentum on their side.
They will do what it takes to get a good result, they will work hard and give a good performance.
A high school football team achieved a feat considered almost impossible in the sport, after the ball bounced off a defender's helmet to score a freak 'own goal'.
On an extra point attempt, kicker Keegan Hemenway was initially relieved when the ball sailed through the air.
The next shock to Hemenay came when the the ball bounced off a defender's head and arched through the uprights giving the opposing team a point.
The bizarre occurrence put the score to 8-0 for Milbank High School and their chances of catching up looked slim.
The point was scored with 35 minutes left in the game.
As it turned out the only real surprise was how bad the rest of the game was for Milbank high.
Dells Rapids high school went on to win the game 51-0.
But the play that was seen by almost every one of the 400, or so, that attended the game must have been a shocking moment for that one Milbank player that the ball bounced off of.
The play has gone viral on YouTube with close to 400,,000 views already.
**Location-based Dating Apps See Huge Growth in User Numbers, with 91 Million Users Worldwide**
Location-based dating apps, such as Tinder and the League, have a combined total of 91 million users.
Now a new study has found that nearly two thirds of these app users are men – and one in five will pay for premium services.
The study's findings suggest that location-based dating apps have become a major part of people's dating lives, with six percent of all web users currently using a location-based dating app.
The study found that the majority of users are young adults.
Sixteen to 34 year olds make up the majority of mobile users of location-based dating apps, with this age group accounting for 60 percent of all users.
This demographic is the most active age group when it comes to mobile dating, with nearly two thirds of people using the internet to find someone to date.
A breakdown of the data also shows that women use these apps for a longer time than men.
On average, a woman uses a location based app for 8.5 minutes per session, but a man uses it for 7.2 minutes per session.
This shows that some women may be more dedicated to finding a match than men are.
Also, some people do not just use these apps for free.
One in five people will pay for some of the premium features that these apps offer.
This can be so they can see who has seen their profile or to find out if someone has liked them.
Some data from the popular app, Tinder, is interesting.
It says that users log on to the app on average 11 times a day.
This is how addictive these apps can be.
They are always open and ready to be used.
They are a big part of people's daily lives.
In conclusion, location based dating apps are popular, very popular.
91 million people use them and that number is not small.
A plane performing at an air show in Davenport, Iowa, crashed and exploded in front of thousands of spectators.
The pilot of the plane was killed in the accident Saturday afternoon when the plane nosedived into an alfalfa field during the Quad City Air Show, officials said.
Details regarding the pilot's identity have not been released by authorities, pending further investigation.
Authorities were quick to respond to the scene and are investigating the cause of the crash.
The accident occurred at approximately 2:00 pm, local time, in an alfalfa field near the airport and the plane went up in flames shortly after hitting the ground.
A nearby resident of the area captured a video of the accident with their home camera, and it is being looked at by the authorities as part of their investigation.
The video, shot from a neighbor's front yard, shows the plane as it comes down, crashing into the ground and going up in flames.
It also shows smoke and flames blowing up from the explosion of the plane.
It is a disturbing video, but it gives us an idea of what happened in the accident.
It is still unknown what caused the plane to go down, but the authorities are looking into several things.
It is also not known at this time if the pilot had any chance to get out of the plane.
The people who were watching the air show were shocked by what they saw, and some of them said they could not believe that the pilot did not have time to get out of the plane.
Samsung has filed a design patent for wearable computer glasses that are tethered to a smartphone.
The Samsung spectacle plugs into a mobile phone and displays information such as text messages and phone calls.

Unlike Google Glass, which is wireless, the Wall Street Journal reports that Samsung's design could have a longer life and be lighter than Google's version, which was initially released to the public and then subsequently pulled back and revised.

The proposed new Samsung design for wearable computer glasses will give the user the opportunity to use their phone calls and listen to music without having to hold their phone, ideal for people who like to be active and work out at the gym and like to watch the phone while they are doing other things.
Samsung has named the design, the'sports glass' and it is not made for people to wear all day, but for people who want to use it during a workout or to watch videos while watching TV.

The design of the sports glasses will be beneficial for people who like to listen to music or get calls during a workout and don't want to have to hold the phone, but the design is not completely wireless, so users will be constantly attached to a cable.

The sports glasses will work with the users phone and they will see what's on the phone on the glasses, including texts, music and calls, but they won't be able to access the internet on the computer with just the glasses and a phone.
The user will have to use the phone and the computer together, with the computer on the phone showing the information.
"It is always good publicity for a Republican if they're in an argument with me,' says Obama.
Sales of governor's book have gone up since the public spat.
By
Daily Mail Report
Last updated at 6:56 AM on 12 June 2011
Former President Barack Obama has made a tongue-in-cheek remark about the benefits of public spats with a Republican.
In an interview on Friday, Mr Obama claimed it is good for the other side's publicity whenever they have an argument with him.
The former President's comment seems to have come true for Arizona Governor Janice Brewer after she clashed with Mr Obama over a number of issues.
The most recent one, being the Air Force One door controversy.
The President had ordered that the door of Air Force one be removed to make way for her motorcade,  then had it put back, so she could exit the plane at the Mesa, Arizona airport.
We reported that the President had an apology to her for the incident.
In an article on the Fox website, it is said that the sales of the Governor's book have risen by 600%.
The sales of it before the public spat with the President, were low.
After the public was told about the spat, the sales have increased.
Arizona Governor Janice Brewer had a public disagreement with the President over the Memorial Day weekend  holiday, and also over a law she wanted to pass but the President didn't agree with.
The law was a bill to require people to show a birth certificate when registering for a government benefit.
The President was against it because, he said, it was mean spirited.
The President thought it would deny some people from getting the help they need.
It seems that Mr. Obama's way of joking about his arguments with Republicans was the joke of the day.
